Name: ConfigurableOreDrops
Author: krasanko0
Description:
[b]What Does This Mod Do?[/b]
Have you ever felt that mining wasn't rewarding enough? Or perhaps you're looking for a more challenging playthrough with fewer resources? [b]Configurable Ore Drops[/b] gives you the power to decide.
This mod allows you to fine-tune the minimum and maximum number of ores you receive from each type of node (Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, etc.). All changes are made easily through an in-game menu, thanks to the support for Generic Mod Config Menu. No more manually editing [code]config.json[/code] files! Simply install the mod, open the menu, and set the drop rates to perfectly match your desired playstyle.
[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Total Customization:[/b] Individually configure the minimum and maximum drop amounts for Copper, Iron, Gold, and Iridium ore nodes.
[*][b]User-Friendly Interface:[/b] All settings are managed in-game via the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].
[*][b]Lightweight & Compatible:[/b] Designed to be simple and compatible with most other SMAPI mods.
[*][b]Change on the Fly:[/b] Adjust the settings whenever you want without having to restart the game.
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
You must have the following mods installed for this mod to work correctly:
[list=1]
[*][b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b]: The latest version is always recommended.

[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b]: Required to access the in-game settings menu.

[/list][b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]First, ensure you have installed the latest versions of SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu.

[*]Download the main file for this mod from the "Files" tab.

[*]Unzip the downloaded folder.

[*]Place the [code]ConfigurableOreDrops[/code] folder inside your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] directory.

[*]Launch the game through the SMAPI launcher. You're ready to go!

[/list][b]How to Configure The Mod[/b]
There is no need to manually edit any files! To change the mod's settings:
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game.

[*]From the title screen, click the [b]gear icon[/b] (Settings) and then find the [b]"Mod Options"[/b] button.
[list]
[*]Alternatively, if you are already in-game, press [code]ESC[/code] to open the menu, go to the "Options" tab, and scroll down to the "Mod Options" button.
[/list]
[*]In the Mod Options menu, find [b]"Configurable Ore Drops"[/b] in the list and click on it.

[*]You will now see a list of all available settings. Adjust the values for each ore type to your preference.

[/list]
